name: anarlog
description: Query Anarlog meetings through Cloud MCP, and fill gaps from the local CLI.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Anarlog account with OAuth, then find meetings and read notes, summaries, participants, action items, bounded transcript excerpts, and recurring history. Cloud MCP is read-only hosted snapshots. When a meeting is missing there, the bundled skill fills the gap from the local Anarlog CLI.
defaultPrompt: What action items came out of my planning meeting?
Compare the last three meetings in this recurring series.
